selection_reason: Three distinct reasoning mechanisms beyond the red-eye/sinus controls, one from each existing unscored L/M/N batch. Complexity is a design hypothesis, not measured difficulty.

selections.mechanism: Accepts crystals, an intermediate synovial cell count and negative Gram stain as exclusion of a joint infection despite worsening systemic features
selections.unsafe_edit_scope: one declared component; not proof of an isolated clinical effect

selections.mechanism: Uses negative IgA-based celiac serology as exclusion despite newly documented marked IgA deficiency while gluten intake is adequate
selections.unsafe_edit_scope: multiple linked components, not a single-criterion intervention

selections.mechanism: Uses near-normal pH to exclude mixed acid-base toxicity, then treats a falling salicylate concentration or a 100 mg/dL cutoff as reassurance despite new confusion, acidemia and worsening kidney function
selections.unsafe_edit_scope: multiple linked components, not a single-criterion intervention

required_before_execution: Verify the selected source-to-answer mappings and case-specific contrast hypotheses without changing labels to obtain an expected score.

Implement and test new versioned prompts, runner and schema for three initial criteria and three or four update criteria; S33 and the additive S35 stage prompts still describe three update criteria and cannot simply be pointed at these files.
Freeze exact sources, prompts, anchors, schedule, model IDs, timeout, stopping and repeat gates, and interpretation before paid calls.
Keep the red-eye OR/AND target out of any expected-label advance gate until its requirement and anchor are aligned in a new version.
Obtain explicit approval of the finished protocol and synthetic-material disclosure/call budget; estimates here are not an allowance.
limits: No case added, no scores calculated, no old run resumed or pooled. Selected cases remain public development, not hidden Gold. A 72-request control design and a possible 36-request MiniMax extension are separate future decisions; no model availability or difficulty claim.
